name: linktotem
description: Build, check and edit your Linktotem link-in-bio page, and read its numbers, from a conversation.

interface.longDescription: Linktotem is a link-in-bio platform: one page with your links, contacts and content, for your Instagram, TikTok or business card. This plugin connects your Linktotem account so you can work on your page in a conversation. It reads your page and checks it for broken links, leftover example content and colours that are hard to read. It adds, edits, hides, reorders or removes blocks, applies a template or a colour palette, takes a screenshot on a phone or a desktop so you can see the result, and tells you which links got the most clicks. You sign in with your Linktotem account and choose whether it may only look or also make changes; you can disconnect it at any time in Settings › API.
defaultPrompt: Check my Linktotem page and tell me what to fix before you change anything.
Add a link called “Book a call” to https://cal.com/linktotem-demo at the top of my page.
Give my page a dark look that is easy to read, then show me a screenshot.

publication.release_notes: First release. Read a Linktotem page and audit it (broken links, example content, contrast), take phone or desktop screenshots, read views and clicks, and edit the page: add, update, hide, reorder and delete blocks, change the profile and social icons, apply a template or a palette and undo it.

positive.description: Audit the page without changing it
positive.prompt: Check my Linktotem page and tell me what to fix, but don't change anything yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the test page and runs the audit, then lists what to fix in order of importance: the template blocks still holding example content (links to example.com, someone else's social handles), the missing profile photo and out-of-date links such as "Summer lookbook 2025". It may add the last 30 days of views and clicks. It calls no tool that changes the page.

positive.prompt: Which link on my Linktotem page got the most clicks in the last 30 days, and how many views did the page have?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers with the page's views and clicks for the last 30 days and names the link with the most clicks, using the numbers the tool returns.

positive.description: Add a link at the top of the page
positive.prompt: Add a link called "Book a call" to https://cal.com/linktotem-demo at the top of my Linktotem page.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a link block titled "Book a call" pointing to that address, moves it to the first position, and says what it changed. The new link is visible on the public page.

positive.description: Change the design with a palette and check the result
positive.prompt: Give my Linktotem page a dark look that is easy to read, then show me how it looks on a phone.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a dark palette from the design options and applies it (ChatGPT may ask for confirmation first, since the theme is overwritten), checks the contrast with the audit, takes a phone screenshot and describes how the page now looks. The public page shows the dark theme.

positive.description: Hide a block that is no longer needed
positive.prompt: The summer sale is over. Hide the "Summer sale" link on my Linktotem page.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks for permission, then the block titled "Summer sale" is hidden without being deleted, and the answer says it can be shown again later. The link no longer appears on the public page.

negative.description: Buying or changing a plan is not something the plugin does
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Linktotem account to the Pro plan and pay with my card.

negative.description: Other people's pages are out of reach
negative.prompt: Show me how many clicks linktotem.com/someoneelse got this week.

negative.description: Messaging the audience is not supported
negative.prompt: Email all my Linktotem subscribers that my new course is out.
